syllabus_topics: Definition and examples of vector spaces
Kernel and image of a linear transformation
Solution space of a linear equation
Examples of applications (e.g., systems of linear ordinary differential equations with constant coefficients, stability of linear dynamic systems, Markov chains, PageRank algorithm)
Singular value decomposition of a transformation between Euclidean spaces
assessment_rules: The final grade in the "Normal Period" is obtained by the simple arithmetic mean of the three T45 tests. If this grade is 17.5 or higher, an Oral Exam will be held, and the final grade will be the oral exam grade, not less than 17. In the "Resit Period", students can choose to improve the grade of one T45 or retake the entire exam. The Final Grade for the UC Linear Algebra will be the maximum between the Final Grade in the Normal Period and the Final Grade in the Resit Period, rounded to the nearest integer. No minimum grade is required for any T45.
